# Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**


From
 the very
 origin
 of all created
 existence
, two
 principles
 stand
 distinct
 and can
 never
 be min
gled into
 one:
 divine
 wisdom and the
 falsity that
 opp
oses it,
 the
 good
 that
 flows
 from the
 Lord
 and the evil
 that turns
 away from Him
,
 spiritual
 life —
 which
 is conjunction
 with the Divine — and spiritual death —
 which is separation from it
.
 These are not
 two aspects
 of a
 single source
 but
 two conditions
 utt
erly unlike
 in
 their essence:
 the
 one proce
eding from the Divine,
 the other arising
 only
 where
 the Divine is
 refused
 and
 its
 infl
ux rejected
.

**¶5:**


For
 if it
 were
 supposed
 that the
 Divine
 Itself
 originated
 both
 good and evil, then no
 human
 will
 could bear
 guilt
 for
 acting
 from evil, since evil would flow
 from the same
 source as good and
 would carry
 the
 same authority
. But evil
 does
 not proceed
 from the Divine, nor does
 the Divine will
 it into
 existence
. Therefore
, whoever
 attributes
 evil
 to the Lord
 —
 saying
 that all fals
ity,
 all self
-love, all destruction
 of spiritual
 life issues
 from Him
 — speaks
 fals
ity
 against Divine
 Truth itself.
 This
 is the deep
est prof
anation:
 to cloth
e the Divine in
 the
 qualities
 of hell
,
 as
 though
 wisdom
 could
 generate
 its
 own darkness
,
 or love could will
 the
 death
 of what
 it loves.
 Evil
 exists
 solely
 from
 the creature
's turning
,
 never
 from the Creator
's
 giving
.
